relevance_note: The paper describes one identifiable patient who carries a TNFAIP3 variant, "a heterozygous variant of uncertain significance in TNFAIP3", with individual-level clinical detail (13-year-old female with pustular psoriasis and CdLS features).
method_note: Read the paper (case report, one patient), the schema and the rules; no script was used to transcribe tables (the paper has no patient table). The paper reports a single proband (single-patient case study, "in a single patient"), so one individuals row. The patient's label follows rule 5: the paper only uses role words ("The proband", "the patient"), never a patient label. A TNFAIP3 variant row is kept with variant_original_string 'c.2199C>A' (printed elsewhere with a space: 'c.2199 C>A'); a RAD21 variant row is kept because the paper attributes it unambiguously to this in-scope person. Inheritance: the Figure 2 and Figure 3 legends call both variants 'de novo', but the paper never states parental testing with the variant absent in both parents, so per D-24/rule 8 inheritance is 'not reported' for both variants. The mother ("a maternal history of cleft palate") and the 'vanishing twin' are not described as persons (no label, no testing, no individual-level description) and get no rows. Contradictions found in the paper: (a) the first skin biopsy 'revealed findings compatible with pemphigus foliaceus' while histopathology later 'confirmed the diagnosis of pustular psoriasis'; (b) the RAD21 genomic location is printed as 'chr8:10,673,499-10,658,686' in the text but as 'chromosome 8: position 116,852,561 (GRCh38/hg38)' in the Figure 2 legend, and section 4.3 says GRCh37/hg19 was used; (c) the RAD21 transcript is printed both as NM_006265.2 and NM_006265.1, and for TNFAIP3 both NM_001270507.1 and 'Transcript: ENST00000612899.5' are printed (the RefSeq NM was put in transcript_as_stated); (d) both variant sections say the variant 'causes change on the Glycine amino acid with termination codon' although the variants are p.(Gln436*) and p.(Cys733*); (e) the TNFAIP3 cDNA is printed as 'c.2199C>A' in the Results but as 'c.2199 C>A' and 'cDNA: c.2197–2199' in the protein section, so variant_original_string uses the Results spelling. The differential 'pemphigus foliaceus' is not recorded as a feature of the patient (it is a biopsy impression that the paper then contradicts). No stacked cells (' / ') and no patient-level tables occur in this paper. No feature is reported absent for the patient, so no phenotypic_features row has status 'excluded'. For the checklist, 'skin lesions', 'growth failure' and 'central nervous system involvement' (from 'Neurocognitive features include dysprosody and limited social interaction') are the only observed items.
